entities.name: Mark T. Vande Hei
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mark Thomas Vande Hei is a retired United States Army officer and current NASA astronaut who has served as a flight engineer for Expedition 53, 54, 64, 65, and 66 on the International Space Station.
